scope: Source-only review of closed-history calculations for frozen operational load, participant quotas, and own/covered time.

contractChecks.frozenHistory: Operational load comes only from immutable company/month or legacy monthly report snapshots. A frozen null remains null; missing comparison under sector/team/query filters remains unavailable rather than being reconstructed from live movements or current rates.
contractChecks.companyScope: Company summaries are selected by visible operational companies; a legacy aggregate is used only if the whole task-company scope is visible.
contractChecks.participantQuota: Owner filtering narrows closures and metricsForProfile applies the participant responsibility share to result-only tasks.
contractChecks.ownAndCoveredTime: Task sessions are filtered to the selected participant; separately frozen coverage sessions are included for that executor and deduplicated by task/session/actor.
contractChecks.existingRegressions: Source tests cover owner/company history, unknown versus zero load, company authorization, frozen coverage time with no owned tasks, removal of live tasks after close, and no duplicate coverage time in global history.

result: No source-level mismatch with the inspected S04 history/participant-filter criteria found.
limits: No test was rerun in this source-review pass; cited regressions are existing tests in the current tree.
This does not replace accepted independent Sol review or establish visual chart acceptance.
externalActions: No service, account, API, commit, PR, or deployment was used.
